title: Jesus... I Forgave Her But I Can't Let Her Back In 🥀
topic: a viewer's comment: she forgave someone close but cannot trust her again, and feels hollow

comment.text: I forgave her but I can't let her back in, and it left me hollow

bible.text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I forgave her. I just can't let her back in. 🥀

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Now I feel hollow, like forgiving should have fixed everything.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Forgiving her was letting go of the debt. Trust grows back slowly, if it can.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So am I still holding a grudge?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not paying her back. You're guarding a wound that's still healing.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: As much as lies in you. Not more than you have. I'll sit with you in that hollow place.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the one who forgave and still keeps the door half shut. 🚪
